tonight.headline: Still no kicker. It's the only thing to do today
body: Your K slot has been empty since 04:39 UTC Thursday, and nothing has changed overnight. ESPN projects you 109.8 to JuiceJam's 112.1, a 49% chance, and it's counting a zero at kicker.
Adding Eddy Pineiro (9.8, free agent) takes your projection to about 119.7. That's the first card. JuiceJam still start Nico Collins, whom Houston have ruled out.

case.label: The Collins hole
case.body: Houston ruled Collins out on Friday (NBC Sports). If JuiceJam swap in Jameson Williams (11.0), they project about 123. You'd be about 119.7 with a kicker, so the kicker doesn't win it alone. It stops you giving away nine points.

case.label: Your Monday back
case.body: Barkley plays Monday night. He upgraded to full practice Friday and says he'll play (NBC Sports, NFL.com), and ESPN no longer lists a designation. The Tuten fallback card is gone.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: JuiceJam leave Collins in. Then a filled kicker slot puts you roughly 7-8 ahead on ESPN's projection.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Free agent, no priority. Do it now; Pineiro kicks off Sunday 14:05 Mexico City
doFirst.title: Add Eddy Pineiro (K). Drop Colston Loveland
doFirst.subtitle: THE DROP IS LOVELAND. Not Kamara, not Vele, not Tuten. Free-agent add, so waiver priority stays at 6.

case.label: The empty slot
case.body: You have no kicker on the roster. Every hour it stays that way, ESPN counts a zero. Pineiro is a free agent: ESPN projects him 9.8 and FantasyPros rank him K3 for Week 3. Jason Myers (K5, 9.4) is also free now if Pineiro goes first.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Loveland has 2 and 3 targets in two games with Caleb Williams (week archive). Williams is out with a hamstring and Tyson Bagent is in the concussion protocol, so Case Keenum, 38 and the third-stringer, starts Monday (Chicago Sun-Times, 25 Sep). Philadelphia have allowed the 3rd-fewest TE points (footballdb). He's 94% owned, and I'm disagreeing with that market on the record: the usage was low even with the starter.

case.label: Why not the others
case.body: Golden and Lloyd have played and can't be dropped. Kamara was added Thursday, so that seat is inside the seven-day churn window. Tuten is Barkley's cover and the Lamar trade piece. Vele is a possible drop, but he's a WR who can still flex; Loveland can't start for you while Keenum is throwing.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Loveland draws six or more targets on Monday with Keenum, or five-plus in two games once Williams returns. Kicker half: Pineiro finishes outside the top 15 kickers this week while Cam Little finishes top five.

doFirst.sources: Chicago Sun-Times · PhillyVoice · FantasyPros · footballdb · week archive

whatWentWrong.title: The kicker slot is still empty, three briefs later
whatWentWrong.lead: Myers went out at 04:39 UTC Thursday for Bateman. Two briefs since have said fill it, and it's still a zero.

case.label: What it costs
case.body: About 9.8 projected points, in a game ESPN calls 49-51. It's the biggest single fix available to you this week, and it costs no priority.

case.label: The fix
case.body: The card above. One add, one named drop.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing. The slot needs filling before Sunday 14:05 Mexico City whatever else happens.

roster.footnote: Golden and Lloyd played Thursday; everyone else plays Sunday or Monday. Grades use footballdb's 2026 points-allowed tables: standard scoring, not PPR, two games. 27th-32nd is Great, 1st-8th is Poor. The K slot is empty and has no row.

lineupCheck.verdict: The tool prefers Loveland over Gadsden on volume, 4 to 3; overridden on a named quarterback fact, since third-stringer Case Keenum starts for Chicago. The tool can't see the empty K slot, worth 9.8 (first card).

trades.theirGainLine: Their gain is +1.7 a week. Tuten replaces Rachaad White's 9.3 at RB2, and Lamar scores them nothing sitting behind Josh Allen.

case.label: Re-checked this morning
case.body: Recomputed from the 12:53 UTC snapshot with Pineiro at kicker: your best lineup goes 119.7 to 123.4, Team 13's goes 123.5 to 125.2. Lamar is still in slot 20 behind Allen in slot 0; White still starts at RB2. On season projections both best lineups gain too (you +46, them +23). Lamar is healthy and starting in Brazil (RotoBaller).

case.label: Honest risk
case.body: Raw season numbers look lopsided: Lamar 297.3, Tuten 166.9. That's why it's a longshot. It also removes Barkley's cover, though Barkley practised fully Friday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Team 13 start a second real back or trade a quarterback, Lamar lands on Baltimore's report, or Barkley is ruled out and Tuten has to start. Don't send it again. Only respond if they open the conversation.

trades.sources: ESPN league file · RotoBaller · NBC Sports
trades.copyText: Hi, would you do Lamar for Bhayshul Tuten? Lamar sits behind Allen and can't score for you, and Tuten goes straight into your RB2 ahead of White. That's about +1.7 a week to your lineup. Propose it in ESPN if you're in.

worthALook.name: Adonai Mitchell
worthALook.lead: The receiver sharing targets with your own starter.

case.label: The role
case.body: 14 targets through two weeks, tied with Garrett Wilson; 12 of them in Week 2 (SI, week archive). TE Mason Taylor is out again.

case.label: The injury
case.body: A jammed finger, not a fracture. He practised Friday with a wrap and is expected to play (SI).

case.label: When to act
case.body: If he out-targets Wilson again at Detroit. Wrong if Wilson draws nine or more and Mitchell fewer than six. Free agent, but there's no seat until the kicker is solved.

worthALook.name: Josh Downs
worthALook.lead: A real role now, and still no seat.

case.label: The role
case.body: Alec Pierce went on IR on 23 Sep (NBC Sports), which DK Network say makes Downs a comfortable WR2 with Daniel Jones throwing. He drew 9 targets in Week 2 (week archive).

case.label: Why not now
case.body: Your one open seat goes to the kicker. The next seat would be Vele's, and Downs projects 12.0 to Vele's 11.6. That's not worth a second move this week.

case.label: When to act
case.body: If Downs draws eight or more targets against Houston, swap him for Vele when rosters unlock. He's a free agent, so it costs no priority.

doNotChase.name: Jason Myers
doNotChase.lead: Your own dropped kicker. Take Pineiro instead.

case.label: The fact
case.body: He's a free agent now, so no priority cost. FantasyPros have him K5 and ESPN 9.4.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Pineiro ranks higher on the same board (K3) and projects 9.8.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Pineiro gone before you act. Then take Myers.

doNotChase.name: Tyler Shough
doNotChase.lead: He projects above Lawrence and he's free. The case for him is box scores.

case.label: The case for
case.body: ESPN projects him 17.7 to Lawrence's 16.4.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: This quarterback slot has already lost 42.8 points to chasing. Lawrence has no injury tag and there's no role fact to override on.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Lawrence getting hurt. You carry no backup, so Shough is the free-agent answer then.

doNotChase.name: Tank Bigsby
doNotChase.lead: A handcuff to your own back, and Barkley is playing.

case.label: The fact
case.body: His rise (1 opportunity, then 16) came while Barkley played through the stinger. Barkley practised fully Friday and says he's good to go (NBC Sports). Bigsby resumed practice Friday from an abdominal injury (NBC Sports).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley ruled out for more than a week and Bigsby named the lead. Tuten covers first either way.

doNotChase.name: Josh Jacobs
doNotChase.lead: The best-looking name on the wire, and he isn't playing.

case.label: The fact
case.body: Earlier this week's reporting had him on the Commissioner's Exempt List (NFL.com, ESPN), and he didn't play Thursday. ESPN labels him DAY_TO_DAY. Not re-searched this run.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: The NFL reinstates him AND Green Bay activate him. Even then, Lloyd is already yours.
